keyPoints.en: A physical quantity is something that can be measured, e.g. length, mass, time.
keyPoints.bm: Kuantiti fizik ialah kuantiti yang boleh diukur, cth. panjang, jisim, masa.

keyPoints.en: There are 7 base quantities: length (m), mass (kg), time (s), temperature (K), electric current (A), amount of substance (mol), luminous intensity (cd).
keyPoints.bm: Terdapat 7 kuantiti asas: panjang (m), jisim (kg), masa (s), suhu (K), arus elektrik (A), kuantiti bahan (mol), keamatan berluminositi (cd).

keyPoints.en: Derived quantities combine base quantities, e.g. velocity = displacement ÷ time → m s⁻¹; force → kg m s⁻² = N.
keyPoints.bm: Kuantiti terbitan menggabungkan kuantiti asas, cth. halaju = sesaran ÷ masa → m s⁻¹; daya → kg m s⁻² = N.

keyPoints.en: Scalar quantities have magnitude only (mass, speed, energy). Vector quantities have magnitude AND direction (displacement, velocity, force).
keyPoints.bm: Kuantiti skalar hanya ada magnitud (jisim, laju, tenaga). Kuantiti vektor ada magnitud DAN arah (sesaran, halaju, daya).

keyPoints.en: Very big or small values use prefixes (k = 10³, M = 10⁶, m = 10⁻³, μ = 10⁻⁶, n = 10⁻⁹) or standard form A × 10ⁿ.
keyPoints.bm: Nilai yang sangat besar atau kecil guna imbuhan (k = 10³, M = 10⁶, m = 10⁻³, μ = 10⁻⁶, n = 10⁻⁹) atau bentuk piawai A × 10ⁿ.

question.en: Write the SI unit of density (mass ÷ volume) in base units.
question.bm: Tulis unit SI ketumpatan (jisim ÷ isi padu) dalam unit asas.

tip.en: Temperature's SI base unit is kelvin (K), not °C — a common trick question.
tip.bm: Unit asas SI bagi suhu ialah kelvin (K), bukan °C — soalan perangkap yang biasa.

keyPoints.en: A scientific investigation follows steps: identify the problem → make a hypothesis → plan & control variables → collect data → analyse → conclude.
keyPoints.bm: Penyiasatan saintifik mengikut langkah: kenal pasti masalah → buat hipotesis → rancang & kawal pemboleh ubah → kumpul data → analisis → buat kesimpulan.

keyPoints.en: Manipulated variable: what you change. Responding variable: what you measure. Constant (fixed) variables: what you keep the same.
keyPoints.bm: Pemboleh ubah dimanipulasikan: yang anda ubah. Pemboleh ubah bergerak balas: yang anda ukur. Pemboleh ubah dimalarkan: yang dikekalkan sama.

keyPoints.en: A hypothesis links the two variables, e.g. 'The longer the pendulum, the longer its period.'
keyPoints.bm: Hipotesis mengaitkan dua pemboleh ubah, cth. 'Semakin panjang bandul, semakin panjang tempohnya.'

keyPoints.en: Plot the manipulated variable on the x-axis and the responding variable on the y-axis. Draw a best-fit line.
keyPoints.bm: Plot pemboleh ubah dimanipulasikan pada paksi-x dan pemboleh ubah bergerak balas pada paksi-y. Lukis garis lurus penyesuaian terbaik.

keyPoints.en: From a graph: gradient = Δy ÷ Δx (use a big triangle); interpolation reads a value inside the data; extrapolation extends the line beyond it.
keyPoints.bm: Daripada graf: kecerunan = Δy ÷ Δx (guna segi tiga besar); interpolasi membaca nilai dalam julat data; ekstrapolasi memanjangkan garis di luar julat.

question.en: You test how the length of a spring changes when you hang different masses on it. Name the three types of variables.
question.bm: Anda menguji perubahan panjang spring apabila jisim berbeza digantung. Namakan tiga jenis pemboleh ubah.

answer.en: Manipulated: mass. Responding: length (extension) of the spring. Constant: the same spring, same original length.
answer.bm: Dimanipulasikan: jisim. Bergerak balas: panjang (pemanjangan) spring. Dimalarkan: spring yang sama, panjang asal yang sama.

tip.en: When drawing the gradient triangle, make it cover more than half of the line to reduce error.
tip.bm: Semasa melukis segi tiga kecerunan, pastikan ia meliputi lebih separuh daripada garis untuk mengurangkan ralat.
